senses.sense_definition: Any of various large insects of the order Mantodea that catch insects or other small animals with their powerful forelegs.

examples.text: The <w>mantis</w> waited patiently on the leaf for its next meal to fly by.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>螳螂</w>耐心地停在叶子上，等待下一顿美餐飞过。

examples.text: A large <w>mantis</w> was perched on the garden fence this morning.

target_lang_translations.zh: 今天早上，一只大<w>螳螂</w>停在花园的栅栏上。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 螳螂目昆虫，以强壮的前肢捕捉其他昆虫或小动物为食。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指螳螂目昆虫，常被称为“刀螂”。

senses.sense_definition: A green colour, like that of many mantises.

examples.text: The walls of the living room were painted in a soft shade of <w>mantis</w>.

target_lang_translations.zh: 客厅的墙壁被漆成了一种柔和的<w>螳螂绿</w>。

examples.text: She chose a dress in a vibrant <w>mantis</w> green for the summer party.

target_lang_translations.zh: 她为夏季派对选了一件鲜艳的<w>螳螂绿</w>连衣裙。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种类似于许多螳螂体色的绿色。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代一种特定的、类似螳螂体色的绿色调。
